newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Foreigners can put $62 bln more in Taiwan stocks.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners can put $62 bln more in Taiwan stocks.

text.p: Foreign investors can put US$62.864 billion more into Taiwan's stock market before hitting an official ceiling, the central bank said on Wednesday.
As of December 9, foreign investors were allowed to invest a total of $73.144 billion in Taiwan's stock market, or 25 percent of the total market value, the bank said in a statement.
Foreign institutions remitted a total of $123.81 million into Taiwan's stock market between December 1 and 9, compared with $421.115 million in the whole of November, the statement said.
June's $912.968 million was the highest monthly figure so far in 1996, it said.
Taiwan also set a ceiling of $3.0 billion for funds raised overseas by local firms through convertible bonds and global depositary receipts.
Of the category, foreigners as of December 9 can still put $1.214 billion more into the island, the bank said.
